rows.commentary: 5.1: Isabella Malgioglio drops it short, allowing Alice Capsey to work a single through the ring towards sweeper cover.
5.2: Isabella Malgioglio loops this one up, and Ashleigh Gardner eases it securely out to deep extra cover for one.
5.3: No run for Alice Capsey off Isabella Malgioglio.
5.4: Alice Capsey does not score off Isabella Malgioglio.
5.5: Dot ball from Isabella Malgioglio to Alice Capsey.
5.6: Isabella Malgioglio keeps it tight, forcing Alice Capsey to nudge the ball into the cover region for a sharp single.
6.1: H Silver-holmes charges in, and Alice Capsey turns the delivery away cleanly toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
6.2: H Silver-holmes targets a tight line, prompting Ashleigh Gardner to dab the ball softly towards backward point for a quick run.
6.3: H Silver-holmes bowls a wide to Alice Capsey.
6.3: H Silver-holmes pitches it up, allowing Alice Capsey to sweep the ball firmly out to deep mid-wicket for a single.
6.4: H Silver-holmes strays in length, and Ashleigh Gardner launches a monstrous strike high over deep mid-wicket all the way for six.
6.5: Ashleigh Gardner does not score off H Silver-holmes.
6.6: H Silver-holmes recovers her length well, inducing Ashleigh Gardner to push the final ball gently into the cover area for one.
7.1: Lauren Smith flights the ball through, with Ashleigh Gardner working it powerfully into the deep mid-wicket pocket to scamper back for two.
7.2: Lauren Smith offers width, and Ashleigh Gardner carves it past the infield down to deep backward point for a boundary.
7.3: Lauren Smith floats this delivery up, enabling Ashleigh Gardner to loft it cleanly over the infield all the way to the long-off fence.
7.4: Lauren Smith keeps testing the batter, and Ashleigh Gardner safely drives this one down the ground to long-on for a single.
7.5: Capsey takes a single off Lauren Smith.
7.6: Ashleigh Gardner does not score off Lauren Smith.
18.3: Nicola Carey strikes as Eva Ragg holes out, safely caught by Chinelle Henry to depart for 3.
18.4: Wide from Nicola Carey to Erin Burns.
18.4: Nicola Carey traps Erin Burns plumb in front for a golden duck, with the lbw appeal rightly upheld.
18.5: No run for Lauren Cheatle off Nicola Carey.
18.6: Nicola Carey delivers to Lauren Cheatle, who works the ball away into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
19.1: Molly Strano claims the wicket of Lauren Cheatle, courtesy of a catch taken by Lauren Smith that ends a brief stay for 1.
19.2: Molly Strano strikes immediately as Sarah Coyte falls for a first-ball duck, caught by Lauren Smith.
19.3: Molly Strano serves up a delivery that Caoimhe Bray knocks down toward long-on to pick up a single.
19.4: Molly Strano serves it up to Alice Capsey, who drives firmly out to long-on and scampers back aggressively for the second run.
19.5: No run for Alice Capsey off Molly Strano.
19.6: Molly Strano tosses this final delivery to Alice Capsey, who carves it majestically away to the deep extra cover fence for four.
7.6: Melie Kerr drops it into her stride as Maddy Green pushes the ball cleanly toward extra cover for a single.
8.1: Dot ball from Sarah Coyte to Maddy Green.
8.2: Sarah Coyte delivers, and Maddy Green guides the red cherry away down to deep backward point to rotate the strike.
8.3: Sarah Coyte keeps it tight, allowing Chinelle Henry to punch the delivery out toward sweeper cover for a comfortable run.
8.4: Maddy Green does not score off Sarah Coyte.
8.5: Maddy Green does not score off Sarah Coyte.
8.6: No run for Maddy Green off Sarah Coyte.
9.1: Frankie Nicklin is greeted by Chinelle Henry, who works the ball away into the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
9.2: No run for Maddy Green off Frankie Nicklin.
9.3: Frankie Nicklin slides one through, and Maddy Green collects a single by flicking it toward deep mid-wicket.
9.4: Frankie Nicklin pitches it up, and Chinelle Henry detonates a drive through deep extra cover all the way to the rope for four.
9.5: Chinelle Henry does not score off Frankie Nicklin.
9.6: Frankie Nicklin finishes the set as Chinelle Henry caresses the delivery down to long-off for a routine single.
10.1: Chinelle Henry does not score off Lauren Cheatle.
10.2: Lauren Cheatle bangs it in, and Chinelle Henry races back for a well-judged couple of runs out toward sweeper cover.
10.3: Lauren Cheatle finds the pads, and Chinelle Henry clips the ball neatly down to fine leg to scamper through for one.
15.3: Ashleigh Gardner drops it slightly too full, and Maddy Green ruthlessly punishes it down the ground for four to long-on.
15.4: Ashleigh Gardner goes back to her length, allowing Maddy Green to maneuver a single out toward deep mid-wicket.
15.5: Ashleigh Gardner floats one up, and Lauren Smith dances down to slam it past long-off for a boundary.
15.6: Ashleigh Gardner keeps it tidy, turning into a single squeezed off the bat by Lauren Smith down to short fine leg.
16.1: Sarah Coyte starts her over by cramping Lauren Smith for room, forcing a quick single away to backward square leg.
16.2: Sarah Coyte strays down leg, and Maddy Green tickles it fine enough to race away to the fine leg boundary.
16.3: Sarah Coyte pulls her length back, inviting Maddy Green to tap it safely into the mid-on region for one run.
16.4: Sarah Coyte attacks the stumps, but Lauren Smith calmly drives it down to long-on to rotate the strike.
16.5: Sarah Coyte drops short, allowing Maddy Green to pump it hard toward long-on and sprint back enthusiastically for a brace.
16.6: Maddy Green does not score off Sarah Coyte.
17.1: Melie Kerr strikes as Lauren Smith holes out to Ellyse Perry, departing for 9 after finding the fielder in the deep.
17.2: Melie Kerr keeps testing the new batter, and Isabella Malgioglio gets off the mark with a single to backward square leg.
17.3: Melie Kerr loops the delivery up on off stump, nudged smoothly by Maddy Green into the cover region for a single.
17.4: Melie Kerr strikes through the gate, dismantling Isabella Malgioglio's defense to leave the batter undone for one.
